all_directory.note: Plain words: since Vince's Exchange policy of 2026-10-22 (3:45 PM ET), and by owner decision of 2026-10-26, EVERY person in the company directory is in scope for mail-to-case and for Teams chats, except the people on the exclusion list (PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS or PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_FILE, integrations/people_exclusion.py). The exclusion list is applied first, before any request. If that list is missing, empty or unreadable, nobody is in scope through this switch (fail closed). The named mailboxes below stay as they are (they are what a capture scope may name one by one). Set enabled to false to go back to the named list only.
